# M-Tech Solutions

> Custom Enterprise ERP Systems, Offline-First Mobile POS, Mobile Parts Inventory SaaS, LMS/CBT Examination Portals, and High-Performance Web Applications engineered by Tuaha Afzal in Lahore, Pakistan for global businesses.

M-Tech Solutions (https://mtechsolutions.online/) is a premier custom software engineering and enterprise architecture firm founded by Principal Software Architect **Tuaha Afzal**. With a **4.98 / 5.0 average client rating** across **50+ production enterprise systems delivered** and **99.9% uptime**, M-Tech Solutions builds bespoke digital infrastructure for retail chains, wholesale distributors, mobile parts importers, educational academies, and scaling startups across Pakistan, the Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia), the UK, the US, and globally.

## Live Production Deployments & Verifiable Case Studies

- [Cadets Coaching Academy — Production LMS & Admissions Portal](https://cadets-coaching-academy-1234.web.app/): Full-stack Learning Management System combining FBISE/Punjab Board classes (1–10) with Armed Forces pre-commissioning, 1:15 batch tracking, and a 750+ question interactive CBT simulator ([GitHub Source](https://github.com/MIAN397/cadets-coaching-academy)).
- [CCA Examination & Testing Portal — CBT SaaS](https://ccap-testportal.web.app/): High-concurrency Computer-Based Testing platform with timed MCQ assessments, cohort directories, instant automated grading, and Firebase Cloud Multi-Sync ([GitHub Source](https://github.com/MIAN397/CCA-Test-portal)).
- [M-Tech Solutions Corporate Platform](https://mtechsolutions.online/): High-velocity agency platform built with React 19, GSAP kinetics, Tailwind CSS 4, interactive quotation maker, and multi-tenant Partner Portal ([GitHub Source](https://github.com/MIAN397/m-tech-solutions)).
- [Tuaha Afzal — Developer Portfolio & Design System](https://portfolio1-omega-gold-99.vercel.app/): Editorial frontend design system featuring custom cursor kinematics, preloader telemetry, and automated contact pipelines ([GitHub Source](https://github.com/MIAN397/portfolio1)).

## Key Performance Benchmarks & Verified Client Impact

- **Adil Computers & Retail Store (Headless E-Commerce & ERP):** +320% storefront speed improvement and zero multi-branch inventory mismatches (Adil Raza, Director of Operations).
- **Al-Razaq Mobile Components (Offline-First Mobile POS):** 100% zero-downtime counter sales and basement warehouse billing during internet outages with automatic background cloud sync (Muhammad Usama, General Manager).
- **Apex Logistics & Trade (Wholesale ERP & Supply Chain):** < 100ms compound SKU and serial lookup query latency across massive wholesale catalogs using optimized MongoDB aggregation pipelines (Ali Khan, Co-Founder & CTO).
- **FutureGen Education Portal (Student LMS Web App):** 15,000+ concurrent active student sessions during peak examination enrollment with zero lag (Dr. Tariq Mahmood, Academic Director).
- **QuickServe Retail Apps (Mobile Order & Barcode App):** 99.98% crash-free session stability with instantaneous camera/laser barcode scanning (Saad Ahmed, VP of Product).
